pick.label: Files to upload
list.label: Files in this upload
title: Upload to {{folder}}
problem.unlisted: This folder can't be read now, so the names already in it are unknown. Close and try again.
problem.tooMany: Up to 5,000 files go in one upload. Pick fewer.
problem.tooBig: Up to 50 GB go in one upload. Pick fewer files.
taken.title: Names already in {{folder}}
choice.keep: Keep both (the new file gets a number)
bad.tooBig: Too large: up to 10 GB a file
bad.noKeepName: No free name for Keep both
bad.name: This name can't be used on the computer
bad.deep: This folder is too deep to upload into
row.taken: Not uploaded: another file took the name
row.refused: Not uploaded: the computer refused it
background: You can close this. The upload keeps going while the Hub is open in this tab.
result.unknown_one: {{count}} file may have gone through: check it before anything else changes here.
result.unknown_other: {{count}} files may have gone through: check them before anything else changes here.
result.overlap: Nothing was sent: another change on {{computer}} is still out or may have gone through. Check it first.
result.off: Nothing was sent: changes are turned off in this Hub session.
held.unknown_one: {{count}} upload to {{folder}} may have gone through: {{names}}.
held.unknown_other: {{count}} uploads to {{folder}} may have gone through: {{names}}.
held.left_one: {{count}} file was not sent: pick it again.
held.left_other: {{count}} files were not sent: pick them again.
held.tooMany: Check the uploads that may have gone through before sending more.
held.unreadable: An upload on {{computer}} can't be read here.
held.tracking: The Hub is tracking an upload to {{folder}}.
held.blocks: Other changes on {{computer}} wait until these are checked.
checkFailed: Couldn't check: the computer didn't answer. Try again.
stopBody: The Hub stops tracking the uploads to {{folder}} on {{computer}}. Files that may have gone through stay as they are. Check the folder yourself.
note.absent: {{name}} was not uploaded: it isn't in {{folder}}.
note.other: Another file now has the name {{name}} in {{folder}}.
